-- fs --
home/evan/Documents/x
home/evan/a.png 1
home/evan/b.md 1
home/evan/c.csv 1
-- script --
option filters kinds
option layout places
start /home/evan
size 100 12
note typing from the sidebar closes it for good, not just for that letter
press ctrl+g
state sidebar true
type b
state sidebar false
state filter b
press ctrl+u
press down down
state current b.md
note and the menu likewise: the arrows after a letter move the folder's cursor, not a menu's
press ctrl+f
state menu true
type c
state menu false
press ctrl+u
press home
state current Documents
press enter
state types ""
state dir /home/evan/Documents
